text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm kicking off a QoS sweep for the continuous-batching changes from PR #812. Need a quick smoke run and a throughput sweep across small/medium/large token profiles. Can someone pick this up?

aj: I can run the smoke and capture tail latencies. Which configs do you want?

maria: thanks @aj — start with: max_batch_size=256, max_tokens=1024, cb_window_ms=6. Then a second pass with cb_window_ms=12. Focus on p95/p99 and median.

leo: pinging infra for GPU availability. @infra-bot any free g4dn pools for a 30m slot?

infra-bot: reserver: allocated 2x g4dn.8xlarge for 30m starting in 10m. Tag: "qos-sweep-maria".

aj: running small profile first (avg reqs: 5 rps, tokens: 64). Command: 
```
./loadgen --target=api.redwood.internal --clients=30 --rps=5 --seq-len=64 --duration=5m --tag=qos-sweep-maria-small
```
I'll post logs after.

hana: FYI — Canary policy will route to model-v2-quant when p99 > 600ms. That could affect throughput, keep an eye.

kevin: I'll watch rollout and have an auto-fallback rule ready in case we exceed error budget.

aj: small run complete. Summary: median=42ms, p95=210ms, p99=450ms, throughput stable. No OOMs. Uploading raw traces to /tmp/qos-sweep/maria/small.log.gz

maria: solid. Next do medium tokens (tokens=512) with same batch/cb_window combos. Also include a burst pattern: spike to 40 rps for 30s every 3m.

loadgen-bot: scheduled run: medium profile in 5m (40rps spikes). Will post artifacts to S3 when done.

leo: quick check — are we enabling prefix-KV caching for these runs or disabled?

maria: disable caching for the sweep to measure baseline batching behavior. We'll follow-up with cache-on runs later.

aj: mid run finished. Observations: with cb_window_ms=6, p99 jumped to ~1.1s during spikes, throughput dipped ~9%. With cb_window_ms=12, p99 reduced to ~750ms and throughput recovered. Attaching quick snippet: 
```
cb_window_ms=6  => p99=1100ms, avg throughput=920 tok/s
cb_window_ms=12 => p99=750ms, avg throughput=1120 tok/s
```

maria: interesting — longer window smoothed burst handling. Any tail latency >2s?

aj: no >2s, highest observed 1.6s in cb_window_ms=6 run.

kevin: noting this for rollout notes. Suggest default cb_window_ms=10 for this model family. We'll A/B for one week.

hana: will that interact with small-batch fallback heuristics? If median drops we might trigger smaller batches more often.

maria: good point. @sre-ops can you add a synthetic check that watches batch-size distribution and alerts if small-batch fraction > 35% for >15m post-rollout?

sre-ops: Yep. I'll add a Prometheus alert: expr = sum(rate(small_batch_count[5m])) / sum(rate(total_batch_count[5m])) > 0.35 for 15m. Alert name: CBSmallBatchSpike.

leo: last run (large tokens=1024) scheduled now. If anyone needs access to artifacts, path is s3://redwood-qos/qos-sweep/maria/2156789012/

maria: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: (1) aj post full artifacts + minimal analysis in the PR, (2) kevin prepare rollout config with cb_window_ms=10 default, (3) hana schedule cache-on runs next week. I'll file a short RFC note. :thumbsup:

aj: Will do. PR #812 updated with results link.

infra-bot: resources released: g4dn.8xlarge x2.

kevin: I'll draft the rollout and ping @eng-oncall before A/B.

maria: closing the loop — great job. :)
